name: Faded Shadowhide Pendant
summary: In Redridge, a voice now sounds from the Faded Shadowhide Pendant. The Shadowhide gnolls wore it to receive Morganth’s orders, and the voice carries Theocritus’s delayed spell.

sections.title: A Broken Network
sections.body: The Shadowhide gnolls of the Redridge Mountains follow Morganth and use enchanted pendants to coordinate their movements. From his sanctuary at Tower Azora, High Mage Theocritus studied the talismans and devised a spell to break into their link. Weeks passed before his broadcast appeared. Now this faded pendant proves the gnolls’ messages can be intercepted, giving Theocritus a way to hinder Morganth’s reach.

sections.title: The Mage's Ambition
sections.body: Theocritus wants to study the pendant and learn how its enchantment endured his intrusion. He hopes to refine his sorcery and send disabling attacks through matching amulets worn across Redridge. The pendant must reach Tower Azora in Elwynn Forest, where he can begin his work against Morganth’s hold over the region’s gnolls.

faq.q: What is the Faded Shadowhide Pendant?
faq.answer: Shadowhide gnolls in the Redridge Mountains wore the Faded Shadowhide Pendant to receive Morganth’s orders. High Mage Theocritus’s broadcast spell has altered it.

faq.q: Why does a voice speak from the pendant?
faq.answer: The voice echoes a spell High Mage Theocritus cast weeks ago. After months of study, he found a way into the pendants’ communication link, and the message shows his spell reached the gnolls’ network.
Theocritus is the High Mage at Tower Azora in eastern Elwynn Forest. He studies dark threats across the border in Redridge, especially the rogue sorcerer Morganth.
Morganth is a sinister rogue magic-user in Redridge. He commands the local Shadowhide gnolls through enchanted pendants.

faq.q: What does Theocritus plan to do with the pendant?
faq.answer: Theocritus plans to study the pendant’s enchantment in his laboratory. He hopes to send disabling attacks through the network and incapacitate any gnoll wearing a matching pendant.

angles.text: As a Mage, you can see magical interception reach even crude or dark enchantments. A disciplined wizard can decode and hijack them.
As an Alliance member, you help Tower Azora weaken the Shadowhide gnolls threatening Elwynn Forest and Lakeshire.
